status: implemented; focused tests pass; headed behavior unverified
scope: manager launch admission for isolated WebKit and asynchronous proxy preparation
finding: Isolated WebKit launch ran as an untracked Task. Busy errors offered Retry and a dismiss-only Cancel, while the admission slot could not cancel the active asynchronous preparation. Repeated attempts therefore could leave the user with the same busy message and no visible recovery action.

behavior: Track isolated WebKit startup in the same cancellable task registry as proxy preparation.
Expose cancellation for the exact active asynchronous admission, including across manager windows.
Keep the admission slot until the cancelled operation unwinds; do not release it early.
Stop a browser process if cancellation races with successful asynchronous startup.

verification.invalidated: SwiftPM performed a fresh package compile because the scratch path was new; no Chromium or owned WebKit runtime rebuild occurred.

limitations: This source fix is not yet in a signed or notarized package.
No claim is made that every reported WebKit startup failure has this cause; the change adds recoverable cancellation and prevents this class of stuck admission.
